landing.kicker: Free, for birders who’d rather be out there
landing.title: Know where the birds are this morning.
landing.lede: Live sightings near you, your honest chances at each spot, and a short route that finds the most of your birds. Get a nudge the moment one you’re after is reported.
landing.fine: No app store, no ads. Works on your phone’s home screen.
landing.liveSub: Uncommon birds reported to eBird in the last 7 days
landing.ebirdDown: eBird didn’t answer just now. Try again in a minute.

landing.stat_other: {{count}} species reported in {{place}} in the last two weeks, and the app knows where each one was.
landing.liveCta: Get told when the birds you want show up here →
landing.oddsText: Every spot gets a real chance figure from recent checklists, faded as reports get old, and checked against what birders actually find.
landing.routeText: Where to go for the most of your birds, in the order that wastes the least driving. Edit it, add any hotspot, send it to Maps.
landing.alertsText: Your watch list, eBird’s rarities, the first migrant of the season back in town. Quiet hours respected, never the same bird twice.
landing.lifersText: Bring your eBird life list in one go. The app points you at birds you’ve never seen, and tells you when one turns up.
landing.step1: Pick your county (an area in Canada, a municipality in Mexico or South Africa). Everything is local: your sightings, your hotspots, your migrants.
landing.step2: Star the birds you want. Or let the notable list and the arrivals pick for you.
landing.step3: Go. Alerts come to your phone; Where to go has the morning planned.
landing.credit: Sightings and hotspots come from <ebird>eBird</ebird>, the Cornell Lab’s community of birders. Bird sounds from <xc>xeno-canto</xc>.
